name: MARAD MSCI Advisories
why: 403 on the full browser UA from a US runner. Third DOT path to return 403; ISW and UKMTO showed the same multi-path signature and ci4 proved it is IP-level (Azure ranges), not headers. Do NOT retry with request-shaping. URL may well be correct.

name: MARAD MSCI Advisories alt
why: Same host as variant a, same 403. Two paths one host = host-level filter by the session-4 rule.

name: MARAD advisories on marad.dot.gov
why: Different host, same agency, same 403 - so the filter is DOT-wide, not per-property. Note travel.state.gov answers 200 from the same runner, so this is not a blanket US-govt block on Azure.

name: MARAD GovDelivery bulletins
why: 406 Not Acceptable is NOT a bot block and NOT a wrong URL - the server parsed the request and refused the media type. Categorically different from the three 403s. GovDelivery is MARAD's documented MSCI distribution channel. Worth exactly one retest with Accept: */* via dump-body.yml. This is content negotiation, not the request-shaping ci4 ruled out.
